title: RootedLabs
tagline: A global network for farmers, agriculture enthusiast's - feeding communities
description: We are creating a network that focuses on using Agritech solutions to feed our communities, fight climate change and find innovative solutions to the rising food crisis globally. The NFT gives them access to funding, voting, data sharing and more. In the long-run we look to use the CookieJar (protocol Guild - funding allocation mechanism) to allow these Hubs with the right onchain credionals to withdraw funding from the main treasury without needing permission.
how_its_made: Using Unlock Protocol for onchain creditionals,  local hubs (think co-ops) will be assigned membership with this dynamic NFT. We have deployed this on Arbitrum. The NFT gives them access to funding, voting, data sharing and more. In the long-run we look to use the CookieJar (protocol Guild - funding allocation mechanism) to allow these Hubs with the right onchain credionals to withdraw funding from the main treasury without needing permission.
